author: Epic Games
description:
The Greymane's Journey, Enhanced. Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new story moments and expanded voice-over and language support.

Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more.

Crimson Desert Enhanced is a free update for all owners of the base game.

Crimson Desert is available for 20% off for a limited time on the Epic Games Store: https://epic.gm/crimson-desert

RECLAIM POWER. REACH BEYOND.

About Crimson Desert  

Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. title: Crimson Desert Enhanced | Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom ONL 2026

author: Epic Games
description:
Are your swords oiled up and sharpened? Potions brewed? Roach saddled? It’s time to face Eredin and his entourage once again!  

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered features an array of improvements, bringing upgrades to visuals, gameplay, and more. It's coming on September 29 and will be available as a free upgrade to all owners of the game on Epic Games Store. 

That’s not all, though! All current owners of the base game will gain access to the two original expansions – Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine – for free! Both of these expansions will also be included in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered base game!  

Get it now on the Epic Games Store. https://epic.gm/the-witcher-3
title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered | Official Announcement Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Silver Palace is an open-world action adventure RPG centred around detective mysteries.  

Step into a city of wonders and deception, where you will investigate bizarre and bewildering cases, forge bonds with an eclectic cast of companions, and write your own story beyond detective work, whether as a rising property magnate or a familiar face at a quaint little café. In Silvernia, every encounter is a choice: to mingle, to investigate, to judge, or to fight. New discoveries, strange encounters, and grand adventures await.

Wishlist now! https://epic.gm/silver-palace
title: Silver Palace | ONL 2026 Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
See even more of the game in the updated and expanded demo for Onimusha: Way of the Sword, the all new entry in Capcom's swordplay action series! Experience the tense swordplay action in the new Oni Refuge area, and battle your way through the Genma hordes to face off against the fearsome boss that awaits at the demo's end, Daidara.      

Demo available now! Experience the exhilarating swordplay action on the Epic and earn yourself the save data bonus! Pre-purchase now! https://epic.gm/onimusha-demo

Footage represents a game still in development. Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.      

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Power
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword | Expanded Demo Trailer
